lawyer: Md Golam Kibria, Deputy Attorney-General with Md Moklesur Rahman Zahid, Assistant Attorney-General------For the State.
parties:
Ibrahim (Md) & others ------ Condemned-Prisoners 
Vs.
State ------ Respondent
full_judgment: 37. The learned Sessions Judge on consideration of the evidence of the PWs, particularly the evidence of PW 1 (informant) and PW 3 Jharna Begum who are the eye-witnesses to the occurrence and also the identifiers of the condemned prisoners in the Test Identification Parade convicted the condemned prisoners for the offence of murder under sections 302/34 of the Penal Code. The evidences of the PWs as adduced in this case are found contradictory, inconsistent and improbable regarding alleged recognition of the condemned prisoners rendering the same unbelievable as it is clear that there has been subsequent embellishment in the prosecution case, not to speak of the fact that there was inordinate delay in holding Test Identification Parade together with evidences of enmity which raised a presumption of concoction. The principle enunciated in the decisions as referred to above by the learned Counsel for the condemned prisoners are found to be applicable in the facts and circumstances of the present case and the sub- missions made by the learned Deputy Attorney- General in this case is found to be not applicable.
